notes: C7: one material per tier (S2). White is bamboo; stone moved to green as S2 proposed. At launch materials only collect.

materials.name: Bamboo
materials.description: Strong and bendy. Builders use it for almost everything.

materials.name: Silk
materials.description: Soft, shiny thread. It is stronger than it looks.

materials.name: Jade
materials.description: A green stone that glows a little in the dark.

materials.name: Stone
materials.description: A piece of the Tower's old wall. Solid and steady.

materials.name: River Pearl
materials.description: A smooth pearl from the Quiet River. It shines like the moon.

materials.name: Forge Iron
materials.description: Warm iron from the Forge of Courage. Strong and helpful.

materials.name: Echo Crystal
materials.description: A clear crystal that hums kind words back to you.

materials.name: Root Wood
materials.description: Wood from the Root Library. It smells like old books.

materials.name: Storm Glass
materials.description: Glass made when the storm passed. It shines like a rainbow.

materials.name: Dawn Gold
materials.description: Golden dust from the summit. It sparkles like sunrise.
